# Peach A local-first video metadata scraper and media manager. [Website](https://peach.video) · [Download](#download-and-use) · [Live demo](https://demo.peach.video) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/peach-mitao/peach?include_prereleases&sort=semver&label=release&logo=github)](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases) [![CI pipelines](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/peach-mitao/peach/test.yml?branch=master&label=CI&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0--or--later-blue?logo=gnu&logoColor=white)](LICENSE) [![Windows x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-x64-0078D4)](docs/TESTING_DESKTOP.md) [![macOS DMG](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-DMG-555555?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](docs/OPERATIONS.md#macos-独立测试包) [![Age restrictions](https://img.shields.io/badge/age-18%2B-555555)](#license) ## Screenshots [![Video library with search, filters and posters](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261025-2.png) Movie demo data; see [asset credits and licenses](https://peach.video/en/credits/).
More screenshots **People and works** [![Charlie Chaplin's profile and films](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261025-2.png) **Creator updates** [![Creator follows and new works](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261025-2.png) **Library statistics** [![Library, storage and viewing statistics](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261025-3-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261025-3.png) **Player** [![Big Buck Bunny player](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261025-2.png)
## Features - **Metadata scraping**: recognize video codes, read NFO files and fill titles, performers, studios and covers from multiple sources while keeping your edits. - **Local and cloud libraries**: browse local drives, SMB, mounted cloud storage and PikPak libraries together. - **Playback and history**: web and external players, subtitles, playback speed, rotation, resume and timeline previews. - **Follows and discovery**: track performer and creator updates, discover titles and manage a want list. - **Cloud download**: search by video code or submit a magnet link, then organize completed downloads into your library. - **Library management**: manage tags, duplicates, versions and parts; permanently delete videos by performer wh
